summary: PSI mobile FCP/LCP/SI are bandwidth-bound by first-party JS that finishes before observed FCP: prod 27 files/567 KB transfer (86% boot closure: entry 257 KB, supabase 58.6, react 61, tanstack 52). Lantern counts every High script ended before observed FCP as render-blocking; fetchpriority=low is ignored (all stay High). Fixture experiments: starting the boot set after load gives mobile FCP 5.04->1.40 s, LCP 5.61->2.66 s, SI 5.04->3.08 s, desktop FCP 1.03->0.38 s, CLS 0; but 600-1125 ms of long-task excess now hidden before simulated FCP would enter TBT (+530..770 ms) unless hydration/parse CPU drops. Entry 1.43 MB pre-min: 62% root/chrome closure, 30% route shells (213 admin), 9% Vite mapDeps. experimentalMinChunkSize 2048 creates cross-route edges (prod entry imports admin.analytics; reproduced). Dictionary 26.9 KB gz is 94% admin/blocks.

findings.claim: Lantern treats any High-priority Script that ended before observed FCP as render-blocking; module scripts cannot use the EvaluateScript escape hatch; LCP keeps every non-low-image node ended before observed LCP regardless of priority.

changes.title: Boot-after-LCP bootstrap: request the boot set after the LCP candidate painted (or first interaction), never before first paint
files: new: scripts/lib/bootSetPlugin.ts (build-time boot-set file list incl. above-fold widget chunks)
changes.mechanism: Stop emitting <link rel=modulepreload> in head and Link for JS; replace the manifest's <script type=module async src=entry> with a tiny inline bootstrap (same markup SSR and client, generated from the manifest so hydration parity holds). It waits for the hero img[fetchpriority=high] load+decode + 1 rAF, or window load, or first pointerdown/keydown/touchstart/focusin, hard cap ~3 s after DOMContentLoaded, then inserts modulepreload links for the whole boot set (entry closure, active-language dictionary, matched route component chunk, above-fold widget chunks) in one burst and appends the module script. Keeps setTimeout(0)-before-hydrate in router.tsx; keeps CSS/font/LCP-image preloads.
changes.metric: FCP, LCP, SI (mobile + desktop); TBT side effect
changes.expected_effect: Fixture measured: mobile FCP -3.6 s (5.04->1.40), LCP -2.95 s (5.61->2.66), SI -1.96 s (5.04->3.08); desktop FCP -0.65 s, LCP -0.54 s; CLS 0. Without CPU cuts TBT +0.5..0.8 s mobile (score ~74); with TBT <=335 ms score ~88, <=250 ms ~91.
changes.estimate_basis: HTML-rewriting proxy over the unmodified artifact (variant defer-load-pre, n=3 mobile, 3 desktop), Lantern source rules (F2), counterfactual TBT from control long-task lists (F5), LH13 scorer.
changes.risk_notes: Hydration starts later on real devices (by roughly hero transfer time); early clicks on JS-only controls wait (links work natively). Boot set must include above-fold widget chunks or CLS 0.42 hydration-discard can recur (F6). BOOT_DEAD_TIMEOUT_MS 15 s watchdog (src/lib/observability/bootProbeScript.ts:68) must not fire. Speculation rules / edge-cached Link headers change. Requires TBT reductions from hydration/html-weight workstreams in the same wave.
changes.verification: measure-local.sh 3 runs: no first-party script ends before observed FCP/LCP (network-requests), FCP<=1.6 s, LCP<=2.8 s mobile on fixture, CLS 0 in >=5 runs; e2e boot test shows __nesAppReady; PSI after deploy.

Lantern: TBT/SI -20..-50 ms; FCP/LCP ~0 unless they end before observed LCP.

changes.title: Lazy Supabase facade: no SDK in the boot closure for anonymous readers
changes.mechanism: Client-only Proxy: from/rpc/schema return a chain recorder (thenable) replayed on postgrest-js (guests, lazy ~8 KB gz chunk with identical apikey/Authorization/x-tenant-host headers) or on the full SDK (stored session or after any auth call); auth.getSession() resolves {session:null} for guests without loading; onAuthStateChange queues listeners until the SDK loads; storage.getPublicUrl computed synchronously; channel/functions/other auth.* load the SDK; storage event on sb-*-auth-token triggers load. Server keeps the static client.
changes.expected_effect: Boot closure -58.4 KB gz / -224 KB raw; without C3 mobile FCP/LCP/SI ~-0.3 s, desktop ~-50 ms; bootup -57..-130 ms simulated (vendor-supabase bootup in LH).
changes.estimate_basis: Inventory bytes x 5-7 ms/KB; LH bootup-time for vendor-supabase (baseline2 130 ms, bootjs runs 57-130 ms).
changes.risk_notes: Builder identity/instanceof users, listener ordering on sign-in, attachSupabaseAuth short-circuit, preview frame (hasStoredAuthSession returns true in frames), 824 rpc + 336 from call sites rely on chain semantics; needs replay unit tests and e2e login/logout/cross-tab.
changes.verification: Boot closure without vendor-supabase (inventory); guest page load: no vendor-supabase request; signed-in load: SDK loads before roles query; LH pre-FCP bytes -58 KB.
